summary: Raeena Lari co-championed a Gaza ceasefire resolution at the Santa Clara County Board of Education in January 2024, acknowledging the suffering of Palestinian and Israeli children and affirming a stance against anti-Semitism and Islamophobia. She is a confirmed member of the pro-Palestine Muslim community, and CAIR Action endorsed her in the 2026 general election. BAMC Action also supported her candidacy, noting her long service as a trustee.
